'''2009 Worlds Day 2 James Barnes DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' JCB213
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
